messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites MS C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstdio>
#include <functional>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <stack>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>

#define FAST_READER std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false); std::cin.tie(nullptr);
#define all_(v) (v).begin(), (v).end()
#define for_(i, a, b) for (int i = (a); i < (int)(b); i++)
#define ford_(i, a, b) for (int i = (a); i > (int)(b); i--)
#define foreach_(it,S) for(__typeof((S).begin()) it = (S).begin(); it != (S).end(); it++)
#define sz_(v) ((int)(v).size())
#define mp_ std::make_pair
#define pb_ std::push_back
typedef long long LL_;
typedef long double LD_;
template<class T> T sqr_(T a) {return a * a;}
template<class T> T abs_(T a) {return a > 0 ? a : -a;}
template<class T> T sgn_(T a) {return a > 0 ? 1 : (a < 0 ? -1 : 0);}

using namespace std;

long long calc(long long n) {
	if (n == 0) return 0;
	long long k = 0, amt = 0;
	while (k * 10 + 1 <= n) k = k * 10 + 1, ++amt;
	long long res1 = amt * (n / k) + calc(n % k);
	long long res2 = amt + 1;
	n = 10 * k + 1 - n;
	res2 += amt * (n / k) + calc(n % k);
	return min(res1, res2);
}

int main() {

#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE 
	freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin); 
	freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout); 
#endif 	
	
	FAST_READER;

	long long n;
	cin >> n;
	cout << calc(n);

	return 0;
}
